top_signals.title: Jain's Fund to Manage Money Just for Millennium
top_signals.summary: Bobby Jain's multistrategy hedge fund made about $1.8 billion in trading profits over two years while managing other clients' capital. Now it's going to manage money exclusively for Millennium Management. Bloomberg's Hema Parmar reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: SNP slammed for ‘mind-boggling’ food price cap plans
top_signals.summary: The Scottish government has been criticised for its “mind-boggling” plans to impose price caps on major retailers operating in the country, including Tesco, Sainsbury’s and Aldi.  The Scottish National Party (SNP) has published a draft bill for the policy, which has been dismissed as an “unnecessary exercise” by leading retailers.  SNP leader John Swinney’s initial [...]

top_signals.title: Europe’s Wind Power Buildout Jumps 30% in First Half
top_signals.summary: New wind power capacity in Europe reached 8.8 GW in the first half of the year, up about 30% from a year earlier, according to WindEurope data cited by Reuters. The annual increase was driven by Germany as well as strong growth in offshore wind installations, the industry body said. New wind capacity additions in Germany accounted for 39% of Europe’s total for the first half of the year, or 3.4 GW. This meant that at the end of June, there was 311 GW in installed wind power generation capacity on the continent. The first-half 2026 figure…
